slot_note: DQ25 seed (low-level channels near the detection limit): the world, the decision and the quantity kept; the pitfall re-found from the data under the 10/10 rules.
niche: a district council's eight water treatment plants, each with one three-stream online ammonia analyser reading raw, filtered and final water through its own sample line and one shared measuring cell, monthly 0.100 mg/l checks through the check port, weekly laboratory grabs whose treated-water results sit under the 0.030 detection limit, and the technicians' monthly sample-line flush in the analyser register's maintenance log
answer: Flag BRN-FW1, CAL-FI1, DUN-FW1, ELS-FW1, GAR-FI1 and GAR-FW1 in the fourth-quarter 2027 return: these six treated-water channels read more than 0.005 mg/L as N off the water at their sample points.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file correctly, fits each analyser's carryover from both slots before, reads Holmedale's check shortfall as a zero error and Calderwood's as a span error from the raw pairs once the raw port's own carryover is out, and takes the passing checks and the censored treated grabs as showing nothing more flags HOL-FI1 with BRN-FW1, DUN-FW1, ELS-FW1, GAR-FI1 and GAR-FW1 and leaves CAL-FI1 at about +0.001; the check standard enters at the check port and the grabs come from the tap, so neither sees what each filtered sample line takes before the cell, which only the readings' recovery after the monthly line flushes measures.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each treated channel's mean offset from the ammonia in the water at its sample point: the analyser's carryover and two-point calibration plus the ammonia its own sample line consumes before the cell, which the instrument field reads from the response to cleaning the line (unchlorinated filtered water grows a nitrifying biofilm that a hypochlorite flush clears and that grows back over days, while the chlorinated final water line stays clean); a hospital's or a grid's nouns have no sample line, no biofilm, no flush and no check port that bypasses the line, so the task does not survive the swap.

stakeholder_role: the council's water quality compliance officer, who flags channels in the quarterly online monitoring return and lists them for the instrument technicians before the next quarter

spine.entity: one ten-minute reading of one sample point by one works' analyser

world.org_type: a district council's water services unit

driver: The decisive quantity is each channel's mean error against the truth, part of which arises upstream of every reference the instrument is checked against (the reference standard enters after it and the field samples are drawn beside it and fall below their detection limit) and is cleared by a routine maintenance step and grows back over days, so it shows only in the channel's own readings recovering after each maintenance visit; a channel whose upstream loss cancels its other errors is left flagged and one whose loss alone takes it past the limit is missed.
driver_concrete: Each treated ammonia channel's quarter offset is its carryover from the two ports before it and its analyser's two-point calibration error, plus the ammonia its own sample line takes before the cell: Calderwood's and Holmedale's filtered water lines (unchlorinated) carry a nitrifying biofilm that takes about two thirds and nearly all of the filtered water's ammonia when grown, cleared by each monthly line flush in the register's planned maintenance log and grown back over about two days, so their readings jump at every flush and fall back; Holmedale's loss cancels its carryover from the raw port and HOL-FI1 sits within the band, while Calderwood's carries CAL-FI1 about 0.010 low.
stump: A competent solver fits each analyser's carryover from both slots before, reads Holmedale's check shortfall as a zero error and Calderwood's as a span error from the raw pairs, and flags HOL-FI1 with BRN-FW1, DUN-FW1, ELS-FW1, GAR-FI1 and GAR-FW1, leaving CAL-FI1 at about +0.001; the filtered sample lines at Calderwood and Holmedale lose ammonia to a biofilm each monthly flush clears, measured by the readings' recovery after the flushes, and with it HOL-FI1 falls inside the band and CAL-FI1 reads about 0.010 low, so the list swaps HOL-FI1 for CAL-FI1.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each channel's mean error against the truth, made of a share of the two samples before it carried into each reading (read from the zero-lag response, apart from the stream's own lagged response) and the instrument's calibration error, whose form (a constant offset or a proportional gain) a check at one level cannot tell apart and a reference at a higher level settles only once that reference channel's own carryover, which also reads in proportion, is taken out; read without it, the constant error looks proportional, so an instrument whose constant error cancels one channel's carryover is left flagged.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each treated ammonia channel's quarter offset is its sequencer carryover from the two ports read before it (fitted apart from the raw-water breakthrough that arrives after each plant's transit times) plus its analyser's calibration error at the channel's own level; Holmedale's 0.008 check shortfall looks like a span error because its raw port also reads about 10 per cent low against the weekly raw grabs, but that is its own carryover, and with it taken out the grabs show a constant zero error that cancels the final water channel's memory carryover, while Calderwood's shortfall, on a healthy analyser, is a span error that shrinks to about 0.002 at treated levels.
lineage.stump: A competent solver fits each treated channel's carryover, reads Holmedale's and Calderwood's low checks as span errors because both raw ports read about as low against the laboratory's raw grabs, and flags HOL-FW1 beside BRN-FW1, DUN-FW1, ELS-FW1, GAR-FI1, GAR-FW1 and HOL-FI1; Holmedale's raw port reads low through its own carryover, and with that taken out its grabs show a constant 0.008 zero error that cancels HOL-FW1's memory carryover, so the list is the six.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 at stage 4 round 4: reader H landed the six (carryover from both slots before fitted per analyser, Holmedale's zero shift and Calderwood's span error read from the raw pairs) and ask B 8 of 8; reader G filed HOL-FW1 for GAR-FW1; judge DETERMINISTIC APPROVE. A measurement model whose every term the readings and the grabs identify was solved by one careful reader in eight.

notes: Probed before the draw: three call-only rounds on carryover designs (3 of 3, then 1 of 3 landed); this design, Holmedale worn as well as zero-shifted, 0 of 3 (pr252f). stump_strategy decomposition_attribution: each channel's error is split into carryover and a calibration error, and the calibration error's form (zero or span) is attributed from two levels once the reference channel's own carryover is removed. calibration_form physical_verification: the monthly check standard through the analyser's check port. layer2_family field_method: the zero and span two-point calibration and the multi-stream carryover correction are the instrument field's own methods. forcing_event period_close (redrawn from launch_or_rollout, which repeats task177): the quarter has closed and its online monitoring return is compiled; the call is retrospective because the return flags the quarter just closed and the list sends the channels to the technicians before the next one. Architecture 2 (2026-10-21): probes on two packs before the draw. Pack 1 (the loss on Brannock's and Elstow's filtered lines, whose grabs sit above the detection limit): probes A, B and C flagged both straight from the lab pairs without the mechanism, so the loss moved to the two filtered lines whose grabs are all censored. Pack 2 (Calderwood and Holmedale): probes D and F filed the default list or the one-slot list and never read the flushes. gap objective first: the checks and the grabs are correct and pass or censor, and the return is scored on the water at the sample point, upstream of where the check enters; generators G9 first: what reaches the cell downstream against what was in the water at the sample point upstream. gate_g decomposition_attribution: the readings' rise after each flush is a correctly recorded movement assigned to its driver (the line's biofilm cleared, not the water or a settling transient), and each channel's error is split into carryover, calibration and line components. stump_strategy decomposition_attribution: each channel's error is split into carryover, calibration and line components, the line component attributed through the flushes.

differentiation.task251: 251 reads count stations' error from paired approaches on one stream (a queue loss and a cold miss outside the validation days); here no second instrument sees the stream: the error is the analyser's own carryover from the samples before, separated from the water's lagged response, and its calibration error's form read from two levels
differentiation.task250: 250 forecasts how many drift alerts a wider limit raises from a record its repairs cut short; here nothing is forecast: each channel's quarter offset is estimated from the analyser's own readings, its checks and the raw grabs
differentiation.task254: 254 times a unit through recorded stages whose later delay is censored; here the G7 window is the check's single operating level against the channel's own, and the decisive step attributes a check shortfall to a zero or a span
differentiation.task244: 244 removes spurious moves between two periods' states read with a measured classification error; here no state is classified: the quantity is an instrument's continuous offset, and the reference it is read against is itself diluted by the instrument's carryover
differentiation.task202: 202 recovers the within-unit shape of a distribution from the minority that reported item by item; here no distribution is cut: each channel's mean error is the analyser's own carryover plus a calibration error whose zero or span form is read from two levels
differentiation.task243: 243 recovers the share of exits a register records from the counts above each age at two dates; here the quantity is an instrument's continuous offset, read against a reference channel the instrument's own carryover dilutes
differentiation.task252 (v1, lineage): v1's decisive step was the carryover from both slots before and the zero or span form of the calibration error, every term identified by the readings, the checks and the raw grabs; here that whole model is the default path, and the decisive term is the loss in each filtered sample line, which no check, grab or fit to the readings sees and which only the recovery after the monthly line flushes measures
differentiation.task251 (v1, lineage): 251 v1 read a reference's own loss from the jump when an exhausted reference was swapped, in the check readings themselves; here the references are sound and blind to the loss by where they enter (the check port after the line, the grab at the tap), the loss sits in the channel's own regular readings, and the event that resets it is a cleaning, not a reference change, logged in the register's maintenance sheet
